title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.33 (quiet) at 07:00 UTC on 8 October 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 10 月 8 日 07:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.33（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 0.33 (0P) at 07:00 UTC on 8 October 2026. The 07 hour is complete (60 samples through 07:59; hour-start 0.33/0P, hour-end 1.00/1Z). Last-180 maximum is 1.33 (first at 2026-10-08T05:59:00Z; label 1P). Published-window maximum is 1.67 (first at 2026-10-08T05:19:00Z; label 2M). Window starts 2026-10-08T03:01:00Z (358 samples). Window estimated_kp reached 1.67. The 08 UTC hour on 8 October is incomplete (59 samples through 08:58).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The card uses the latest hour that has a full 60 samples; the following hour may still be incomplete.
evidence.method: NOAA SWPC planetary_k_index_1m.json. Main card is the hour-start estimated_kp of the latest complete hour. last-180 and published-window maxima are the first occurrence of the maximum estimated_kp in each window.
